moments.title: Autumn Nations Championship Finals Weekend
moments.blurb: The inaugural Autumn Nations Championship concludes today with Finals Weekend at Twickenham, featuring England vs New Zealand in the 3rd Place Play-off and South Africa vs France in the Grand Final.

angles.name: Finals Day Buzz
angles.copy: It's Finals Day at Twickenham for the Autumn Nations Championship! Who are you backing for the big one – South Africa or France in the Grand Final? Kick-off 4:40pm.

angles.name: England vs All Blacks
angles.copy: England face the mighty All Blacks in the 3rd Place Play-off today at Twickenham at 4:40pm. Can they finish their Autumn Nations campaign on a high?

angles.name: Wales & Scotland in action
angles.copy: Wales take on Japan and Scotland face Argentina in their respective play-off matches today at Twickenham. Wishing both nations the best of luck!

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Final Week
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! continues nightly, with the King or Queen of the Jungle expected to be crowned on Monday, December 7th.

angles.name: Jungle Countdown
angles.copy: The jungle adventure is nearly over! I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! is set to crown its winner on December 7th. Who's your pick for King or Queen?

angles.name: Final Week Drama
angles.copy: It's the final week in the I'm A Celeb jungle! Expect more trials, tears, and triumphs as the campmates battle it out for the crown.

moments.title: Official UK Singles Chart Updates
moments.blurb: JYT holds the top two spots with 'I Wanted You' and 'Which One?' on this week's Official UK Singles Chart, while Christmas classics like Brenda Lee's 'Rockin' Around The Christmas Tree' make their annual re-entry.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: JYT are dominating the charts this week, holding both the #1 and #2 spots! What's your favourite from 'I Wanted You' or 'Which One?'

angles.name: Christmas Chart Invasion
angles.copy: It's official: the Christmas classics are back in the charts! Brenda Lee, Elton John, and The Pogues are all making their festive re-entries. Which is your go-to?

angles.name: New Entry Alert
angles.copy: Enrique Iglesias and Pitbull's 'Ooh Laka Laka La' is a brand new entry in the UK Top 40! Give it a listen and tell us what you think.

moments.title: Mamma Mia! The Musical in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The smash-hit musical Mamma Mia!, featuring the timeless songs of ABBA, begins a one-week run at the Wales Millennium Centre in Cardiff from Monday, November 30th.

angles.name: Cardiff Abba Mania
angles.copy: Get ready for a super trouper week! Mamma Mia! The Musical opens in Cardiff at the Wales Millennium Centre on Monday. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Dancing Queen in Wales
angles.copy: The ultimate feel-good musical, Mamma Mia!, brings its ABBA-filled magic to Cardiff from Monday. It's the perfect pre-Christmas treat!

moments.title: Phil Beer Live in Exeter
moments.blurb: Award-winning folk guitarist, multi-instrumentalist, composer, and producer Phil Beer is performing a solo evening at Cygnet Theatre in Exeter tonight, Saturday November 28th.

angles.name: Exeter Folk Night
angles.copy: Tonight in Exeter: The incredibly talented Phil Beer is live at the Cygnet Theatre for a solo performance! Don't miss this local legend.

angles.name: Devon's Own Phil Beer
angles.copy: Catch Phil Beer's captivating solo show at Exeter's Cygnet Theatre tonight. A master of folk guitar right on our doorstep!

moments.title: ELVANA: Elvis Fronted Nirvana in Exeter
moments.blurb: The unique tribute act ELVANA: Elvis Fronted Nirvana is performing tonight, Saturday November 28th, at Exeter Phoenix.

angles.name: Elvis Meets Nirvana
angles.copy: Tonight in Exeter: ELVANA - Elvis Fronted Nirvana! Get ready for a wild night of rock 'n' roll and grunge at Exeter Phoenix.

angles.name: Weekend Rock Out
angles.copy: What happens when Elvis meets Nirvana? Find out tonight at Exeter Phoenix with ELVANA! It's going to be loud.

moments.title: Penzance Christmas Lights Switch On

angles.name: Penzance Sparkles
angles.copy: Penzance is lighting up for Christmas tonight! Head down for the big switch-on at 5:30pm and soak up the festive atmosphere.

angles.name: Cornwall Gets Festive
angles.copy: The Christmas lights are going on in Penzance tonight! It’s beginning to look a lot like Christmas in Cornwall.

moments.title: Moretonhampstead Christmas Market & Lights
moments.blurb: Moretonhampstead in Devon hosts its Christmas Market and Lights Switch-On this afternoon, Saturday November 28th, with the lights illuminating at 5:30pm.

angles.name: Devon Festive Fun
angles.copy: Moretonhampstead is getting festive today with its Christmas Market and Lights Switch-On! The big moment is at 5:30pm – see you there?

angles.name: Christmas in Dartmoor
angles.copy: If you're near Dartmoor, head to Moretonhampstead this afternoon for their Christmas Market and Lights Switch-On. Perfect for getting into the festive spirit!

moments.title: Rochester Christmas Market Open
moments.blurb: The Rochester Christmas Market, set in the historic Castle Gardens, is running this weekend (Nov 27-29) and is regarded as one of the UK's premier festive events.

angles.name: Historic Christmas Market
angles.copy: Step back in time at the Rochester Christmas Market, open all weekend in the stunning Castle Gardens! Over 120 stalls with unique gifts and treats.

angles.name: Kent's Festive Gem
angles.copy: Rochester Christmas Market is a must-visit this weekend! Enjoy the magical funfair, live entertainment, and delicious food.

moments.title: Borough Market Christmas Begins
moments.blurb: London's iconic Borough Market transforms for Christmas from Monday, November 30th to December 31st, offering festive food, drinks, and a magical atmosphere.

angles.name: London's Foodie Christmas
angles.copy: Borough Market gets its festive facelift from Monday! Get ready for a month of delicious Christmas food, mulled wine, and unique gifts.

angles.name: Christmas in the Capital
angles.copy: London's Borough Market kicks off its Christmas season on Monday. Perfect for foodies and festive shoppers alike!
